## Doctor: a queued roadmap is not an owner-queue entry

A queued roadmap waits for the owner's word by definition; that is what "queued" means. Until now the doctor still
added a `word` entry `start queued roadmap <slug>: <trigger>` to `owner_queue` for every queued roadmap, so a
dashboard reading `state.json` showed each adopting app with a queued roadmap as "waiting for the owner", with the
roadmap as a permanent inbox entry (#109).

### `softure-doctor` (`context_state.py`)

- **No `start queued roadmap …` entry any more.** A queued roadmap appears only under `state.json` → `queued`
  (slug, title, status, path, `start_condition`, done/total, items), which a dashboard shows in its roadmaps view.
- **`owner_queue` holds only what really blocks work:** owner steps, secrets, the release word and owner decisions.
  A queued roadmap's own `## Owner decisions and checks` entries stay in the queue as before.
- A project whose only open owner item is a queued roadmap is no longer "waiting for the owner".

WORKFLOW §5.1, §8.6 and §12.1 say the same. No flag and no second shape.

### Adopting projects

Nothing to do by hand: the next skills bump regenerates `context/state.json` and the `start queued roadmap` entries
leave the owner queue.

Install from npm: `npm i -D @softure-ai/skills@0.41.2`

Install from this release (no registry, no auth): `npm i -D https://github.com/SOFTURE/SKILLS/releases/download/v0.41.2/softure-ai-skills-0.41.2.tgz`

GitHub Packages: `@softure/skills@0.41.2` (requires a token with read:packages)
